stages.source_step_group_scope: 50-ms simulation / 100-ms sensor configuration; includes all synchronous writes and queue blocking
stages.state_maxima_scope: sampled after normal sensor ingest/local advance; not peaks within a call or EOF
stages.publication_latency_scope: Start/end/seal refer to logical window boundaries mapped to source-state wall starts; EOF uses aggregation_finish start. ACK is recipient database acknowledgment before private-journal commit, not external client receipt. No external source schedule is implied.

limitations: Real stochastic simulation, not matched headless/renderer trajectories.
Motion noise depends on real elapsed time.
Renderer is sole pacing owner; headless is unpaced.
Queue write duration includes locking/copying plus waiting.
Instrumentation buffers events privately and adds measurement overhead.
Publication store spans include serialization, journal and acknowledged recipient operations; not network-only latency.
Source-to-display starts at producer state processing; not sensor external arrival time.

mongo.publication_contract: fresh no-retry namespace; complete recipient/journal payload equality checked by Mongo audit

limits: Native runs are sequential descriptive measurements, not hard deadline guarantees.
Only same-input replay full/off comparisons isolate the diagnostic mode.
Two live probes use different random trajectories and renderer settings; their wall times do not isolate a speed improvement.
The adapter omits actual MongoDB writes, raw sensor/GT writes, motion and rendering; live scopes measure these separately.
Per-stage timings include measurement overhead; nested spans overlap and are not summed.
No new movement was exported; all test databases were removed.

quantile_definitions.paired_replay_profile: Select sorted[integer((n-1)*p+0.5)], nearest zero-based index with ties upward; baseline and repeated actual-API profiles use this same rule.
quantile_definitions.comparison_note: At n=400 and p=.95 the indexes agree; at n=199 the sample-step p95 can differ by one rank. No raw timings or measured run outputs were rewritten.
